headline: AI-designed phages kill lab bacteria, raising biosecurity questions
summary: Researchers tested AI-generated bacteriophages against non-pathogenic E. coli while emphasizing safety constraints and the need for governance.
script: AI-designed bacteriophages killed laboratory E. coli. The work used non-pathogenic bacteria, but it raises a bigger question: can biosecurity rules keep pace with synthetic biology?
imageAlt: Arc Institute diagram showing the design template for an engineered bacteriophage.
imageAltTwo: Arc Institute diagram showing laboratory testing of an engineered phage.

sources.title: First synthetic phages designed by a language model

selection.basis: A genuinely new lab capability with an explicit safety boundary and a consequential governance question; ranking is editorial, not an objective trend metric.
